method: Engine record-anchored calorics (EqID reference_species_calorics): neutral species carry the ideal-gas records below; ions are completed from the R1-R5 reaction enthalpies RT^2 (ln K_rho)' on the Engine's density basis; the ionic charge gauge cancels in electroneutral phases

carbon-dioxide.source: NIST WebBook Shomate (Chase 1998), 298-1200 K; CODATA formation enthalpy

water.source: NIST WebBook Shomate (Chase 1998), fitted 500-1700 K, used from 273.15 K

monoethanolamine.source: Zhang, Que and Chen 2011 Table 3 (Aspen), 283-1000 K; anchor h = s = 0 at 313.15 K (moiety convention)

adoption: unadopted neutral inputs; absorption heat at fixed T does not depend on them
